skill_name: Describe a type of relationship between living organisms that presents in an ecosystem
workflow: A relationship between living organisms that is present in an ecosystem is called symbiosis. Symbiosis describes the relationship between two or more organisms that live and interact together, providing benefits to each other. Examples of symbiotic relationships include mutualism, commensalism, and parasitism.
